title: Xiaomi Huami Amazfit Bip Lite
symptom: User wants to integrate Xiaomi Huami Amazfit Bip Lite with xDrip+ but only finds 'AmazFit Sync Service' in Settings - Smart Watch Properties, with no further options to integrate the watch.
cause: The Amazfit Bip runs its own OS and is less powerful, unlike Pace, Stratos, and Verge which run Android. The Amazfit Service in the master repository is not up to date.
fix: For Pace/Stratos, install the watchface on the watch and activate the service on the phone, using the latest release of Klaus3d3's fork until a new pull request is made. For Bip, no direct integration; workaround involves using the app 'Tool & Amazfit' to receive notifications with BG and delta values, with settings described in a linked guide.
evidence_quote: The watchface needs to be installed to the watch and on phones side you must activate the service. The Amazfit Service in this master repository is not up to date. Therefor use the latest release of my fork until i made a new pull request.
